def test_download_candles_delta_time_delta_calculation(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест правильного расчета временного дельта для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    
    # Тестируем разные разрешения
    test_cases = [
        ("hour", datetime.timedelta(hours=1)),
        ("15min", datetime.timedelta(minutes=15)),
    ]
    
    for resolution, expected_delta in test_cases:
        with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
             patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download:
            
            # Устанавливаем фиксированное время для теста
            last_dt = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            mock_get_last_dt.return_value = last_dt
            
            # Act
            data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, [resolution])
            
            # Assert
            # Проверяем, что start_date правильно вычисляется
            mock_training_download.assert_called_once()
            
            # Получаем все вызовы для данного разрешения
            calls_for_resolution = []
            for call_args in mock_training_download.call_args_list:
                if call_args[0][1] == [resolution]:
                    calls_for_resolution.append(call_args)
            
            assert len(calls_for_resolution) == 1
            call_args = calls_for_resolution[0]
            
            assert call_args[0] == (["SBER"], [resolution])
            assert call_args[1]["start_date"] == last_dt + expected_delta
            assert call_args[1]["save_mode"] == "append"
            
            # Сбрасываем моки для следующей итерации
            mock_get_last_dt.reset_mock()
            mock_training_download.reset_mock()

def test_download_candles_delta_happy_path(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест нормального поведения: успешная загрузка дельты данных."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER", "GAZP"]
    resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    # Мокаем методы, которые вызываются внутри
    with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
         patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download:
        
        # Настраиваем возвращаемые значения для каждого тикера и разрешения
        mock_get_last_dt.side_effect = [
            datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # SBER hour
            datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # SBER 15min
            datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP hour
            datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP 15min
        ]
        
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Проверяем, что get_candles_last_dt вызывался с правильными параметрами
        assert mock_get_last_dt.call_count == 4
        expected_calls = [
            call("SBER", "hour"),
            call("SBER", "15min"),
            call("GAZP", "hour"),
            call("GAZP", "15min"),
        ]
        mock_get_last_dt.assert_has_calls(expected_calls, any_order=True)
        
        # Проверяем, что training_datasets_download вызывался с правильными параметрами
        assert mock_training_download.call_count == 4
        
        # Проверяем вызовы для SBER hour
        sber_hour_calls = [c for c in mock_training_download.call_args_list 
                          if c[0][0] == ["SBER"] and c[0][1] == ["hour"]]
        assert len(sber_hour_calls) == 1
        assert sber_hour_calls[0][1]["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        assert sber_hour_calls[0][1]["save_mode"] == "append"
        
        # Проверяем вызовы для SBER 15min
        sber_15min_calls = [c for c in mock_training_download.call_args_list 
                           if c[0][0] == ["SBER"] and c[0][1] == ["15min"]]
        assert len(sber_15min_calls) == 1
        assert sber_15min_calls[0][1]["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        assert sber_15min_calls[0][1]["save_mode"] == "append"
        
        # Проверяем вызовы для GAZP hour
        gazp_hour_calls = [c for c in mock_training_download.call_args_list 
                          if c[0][0] == ["GAZP"] and c[0][1] == ["hour"]]
        assert len(gazp_hour_calls) == 1
        assert gazp_hour_calls[0][1]["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 14, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        assert gazp_hour_calls[0][1]["save_mode"] == "append"
        
        # Проверяем вызовы для GAZP 15min
        gazp_15min_calls = [c for c in mock_training_download.call_args_list 
                           if c[0][0] == ["GAZP"] and c[0][1] == ["15min"]]

def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    resolutions = ["hour"]
    
    with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
         patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download, \
         patch('time.sleep') as mock_sleep:
        
        mock_get_last_dt.return_value = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        # Первый вызов вызывает исключение с RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, второй успешен
        mock_training_download.side_effect = [
            Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded"),
            None
        ]
        
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Проверяем, что было 2 попытки вызова
        assert mock_training_download.call_count == 2
        
        # Проверяем, что между попытками был sleep
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)
        
        # Проверяем параметры вызовов
        expected_start_date = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        # Проверяем оба вызова
        for i in range(2):
            call_args = mock_training_download.call_args_list[i]
            assert call_args[0][0] == ["SBER"]
            assert call_args[0][1] == ["hour"]
            assert call_args[1]["start_date"] == expected_start_date
            assert call_args[1]["save_mode"] == "append"

def test_download_candles_delta_time_delta_calculation(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест правильного расчета временного дельта для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    
    # Тестируем разные разрешения
    test_cases = [
        ("hour", datetime.timedelta(hours=1)),
        ("15min", datetime.timedelta(minutes=15)),
    ]
    
    for resolution, expected_delta in test_cases:
        with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
             patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download:
            
            # Устанавливаем фиксированное время для теста
            last_dt = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            mock_get_last_dt.return_value = last_dt
            
            # Act
            data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, [resolution])
            
            # Assert
            # Проверяем, что start_date правильно вычисляется
            mock_training_download.assert_called_once()
            
            # Получаем все вызовы для данного разрешения
            calls_for_resolution = []
            for call_args in mock_training_download.call_args_list:
                if call_args[0][0] == ["SBER"] and call_args[0][1] == [resolution]:
                    calls_for_resolution.append(call_args)
            
            assert len(calls_for_resolution) == 1
            call_args = calls_for_resolution[0]
            
            assert call_args[0][0] == ["SBER"]
            assert call_args[0][1] == [resolution]
            assert call_args[1]["start_date"] == last_dt + expected_delta
            assert call_args[1]["save_mode"] == "append"
            
            # Сбрасываем моки для следующей итерации
            mock_get_last_dt.reset_mock()
            mock_training_download.reset_mock()

def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    resolutions = ["hour"]
    
    with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
         patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download, \
         patch('time.sleep') as mock_sleep:
        
        mock_get_last_dt.return_value = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        # Первый вызов вызывает исключение с RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, второй успешен
        mock_training_download.side_effect = [
            Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded"),
            None
        ]
        
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Проверяем, что было 2 попытки вызова
        assert mock_training_download.call_count == 2
        
        # Проверяем, что между попытками был sleep
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)
        
        # Проверяем параметры вызовов
        expected_start_date = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        # Проверяем оба вызова
        for i in range(2):
            call_args = mock_training_download.call_args_list[i]
            assert call_args[0][0] == ["SBER"]
            assert call_args[0][1] == ["hour"]
            assert call_args[1]["start_date"] == expected_start_date
            assert call_args[1]["save_mode"] == "append"

def test_download_candles_delta_time_delta_calculation(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест правильного расчета временного дельта для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    
    # Тестируем разные разрешения
    test_cases = [
        ("hour", datetime.timedelta(hours=1)),
        ("15min", datetime.timedelta(minutes=15)),
    ]
    
    for resolution, expected_delta in test_cases:
        with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
             patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download:
            
            # Устанавливаем фиксированное время для теста
            last_dt = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            mock_get_last_dt.return_value = last_dt
            
            # Act
            data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, [resolution])
            
            # Assert
            # Проверяем, что start_date правильно вычисляется
            mock_training_download.assert_called_once()
            
            # Получаем все вызовы для данного разрешения
            calls_for_resolution = []
            for call_args in mock_training_download.call_args_list:
                if call_args[0][0] == ["SBER"] and call_args[0][1] == [resolution]:
                    calls_for_resolution.append(call_args)
            
            assert len(calls_for_resolution) == 1
            call_args = calls_for_resolution[0]
            
            assert call_args[0][0] == ["SBER"]
            assert call_args[0][1] == [resolution]
            assert call_args[1]["start_date"] == last_dt + expected_delta
            assert call_args[1]["save_mode"] == "append"
            
            # Сбрасываем моки для следующей итерации
            mock_get_last_dt.reset_mock()
            mock_training_download.reset_mock()

        assert gazp_15min_calls[0].kwargs["save_mode"] == "append"


def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    resolutions = ["hour"]
    
    with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
         patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download, \
         patch('time.sleep') as mock_sleep:
        
        mock_get_last_dt.return_value = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        # Первый вызов вызывает исключение с RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, второй успешен
        mock_training_download.side_effect = [
            Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded"),
            None
        ]
        
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Проверяем, что было 2 попытки вызова
        assert mock_training_download.call_count == 2
        
        # Проверяем, что между попытками был sleep
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)
        
        # Проверяем параметры вызовов
        expected_start_date = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        # Проверяем оба вызова
        for i in range(2):
            call_args = mock_training_download.call_args_list[i]
            assert call_args.args[0] == ["SBER"]
            assert call_args.args[1] == ["hour"]
            assert call_args.kwargs["start_date"] == expected_start_date
            assert call_args.kwargs["save_mode"] == "append"

def test_download_candles_delta_time_delta_calculation(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест правильного расчета временного дельта для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    
    # Тестируем разные разрешения
    test_cases = [
        ("hour", datetime.timedelta(hours=1)),
        ("15min", datetime.timedelta(minutes=15)),
    ]
    
    for resolution, expected_delta in test_cases:
        with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
             patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download:
            
            # Устанавливаем фиксированное время для теста
            last_dt = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            mock_get_last_dt.return_value = last_dt
            
            # Act
            data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, [resolution])
            
            # Assert
            # Проверяем, что start_date правильно вычисляется
            mock_training_download.assert_called_once()
            
            # Получаем все вызовы для данного разрешения
            calls_for_resolution = []
            for call_args in mock_training_download.call_args_list:
                if call_args.args[0] == ["SBER"] and call_args.args[1] == [resolution]:
                    calls_for_resolution.append(call_args)
            
            assert len(calls_for_resolution) == 1
            call_args = calls_for_resolution[0]
            
            assert call_args.args[0] == ["SBER"]
            assert call_args.args[1] == [resolution]
            assert call_args.kwargs["start_date"] == last_dt + expected_delta
            assert call_args.kwargs["save_mode"] == "append"
            
            # Сбрасываем моки для следующей итерации
            mock_get_last_dt.reset_mock()
            mock_training_download.reset_mock()

def test_download_candles_delta_time_delta_calculation(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест правильного расчета временного дельта для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    
    # Тестируем разные разрешения
    test_cases = [
        ("hour", datetime.timedelta(hours=1)),
        ("15min", datetime.timedelta(minutes=15)),
    ]
    
    for resolution, expected_delta in test_cases:
        with patch.object(data_manager, 'get_candles_last_dt') as mock_get_last_dt, \
             patch.object(data_manager, 'training_datasets_download') as mock_training_download:
            
            # Устанавливаем фиксированное время для теста
            last_dt = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            mock_get_last_dt.return_value = last_dt
            
            # Act
            data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, [resolution])
            
            # Assert
            # Проверяем, что start_date правильно вычисляется
            mock_training_download.assert_called_once()
            
            # Получаем все вызовы для данного разрешения
            calls_for_resolution = []
            for call_args in mock_training_download.call_args_list:
                if call_args.args[0] == ["SBER"] and call_args.args[1] == [resolution]:
                    calls_for_resolution.append(call_args)
            
            assert len(calls_for_resolution) == 1
            call_args = calls_for_resolution[0]
            
            assert call_args.args[0] == ["SBER"]
            assert call_args.args[1] == [resolution]
            assert call_args.kwargs["start_date"] == last_dt + expected_delta
            assert call_args.kwargs["save_mode"] == "append"
            
            # Сбрасываем моки для следующей итерации
            mock_get_last_dt.reset_mock()
            mock_training_download.reset_mock()
