def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(con=mock_connection, from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_connection
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(con=mock_connection, from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_connection
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

def test_get_schedules_exception_in_get_trading_schedules(data_manager, mock_connection):

    mock_to_sql.assert_not_called()

    assert abs((to_arg - from_arg).total_seconds() - 86400) < 10  # Допуск 10 секунд


def test_get_schedules_multiple_schedules(data_manager, mock_connection):
    """Тест с несколькими расписаниями."""
    # Создаем два мока расписаний
    schedule1 = MagicMock()
    schedule1.exchange = "MOEX"
    
    day1 = MagicMock()
    day1.is_trading_day = True
    day1.date = MagicMock()
    day1.date.date.return_value = datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    day1.start_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    day1.end_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    
    schedule1.days = [day1]
    
    schedule2 = MagicMock()
    schedule2.exchange = "SPBX"
    
    day2 = MagicMock()
    day2.is_trading_day = True
    day2.date = MagicMock()
    day2.date.date.return_value = datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    day2.start_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 9, 30, 0)
    day2.end_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 19, 0, 0)
    
    schedule2.days = [day2]
    
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [schedule1, schedule2]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 16, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(con=mock_connection, from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = mock_to_sql.call_args.args[0]
    assert len(df) == 2  # По одному дню из каждого расписания
    
    # Проверка данных
    assert set(df['schedule'].tolist()) == {"MOEX", "SPBX"}
    assert df[df['schedule'] == "MOEX"]['work_seconds'].iloc[0] == 8 * 3600
    assert df[df['schedule'] == "SPBX"]['work_seconds'].iloc[0] == 9.5 * 3600

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_connection
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

    day2.start_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 9, 30, 0)

    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection

    assert set(df['schedule'].tolist()) == {"MOEX", "SPBX"}
    assert df[df['schedule'] == "MOEX"]['work_seconds'].iloc[0] == 8 * 3600
    assert df[df['schedule'] == "SPBX"]['work_seconds'].iloc[0] == 9.5 * 3600

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_connection
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода с параметрами по умолчанию
        data_manager.get_schedules()
    
    # Проверка, что get_trading_schedules вызван с параметрами по умолчанию
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once()
    
    # Получаем аргументы вызова
    call_args = data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.call_args
    
    # Проверяем, что from_ и to примерно соответствуют дефолтным значениям
    from_arg = call_args.kwargs['from_']
    to_arg = call_args.kwargs['to']
    
    # Проверяем, что from_ примерно сейчас, а to примерно через день
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    assert abs((from_arg - now).total_seconds()) < 10  # Допуск 10 секунд
    assert abs((to_arg - from_arg).total_seconds() - 86400) < 10  # Допуск 10 секунд


def test_get_schedules_multiple_schedules(data_manager, mock_connection):
    """Тест с несколькими расписаниями."""
    # Создаем два мока расписаний
    schedule1 = MagicMock()

    day1.date.date.return_value = datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    day1.start_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    day1.end_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    
    schedule1.days = [day1]
    
    schedule2 = MagicMock()
    schedule2.exchange = "SPBX"
    
    day2 = MagicMock()
    day2.is_trading_day = True
    day2.date = MagicMock()
    day2.date.date.return_value = datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    day2.start_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 9, 30, 0)
    day2.end_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 19, 0, 0)
    
    schedule2.days = [day2]
    
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [schedule1, schedule2]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 16, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = mock_to_sql.call_args.args[0]
    assert len(df) == 2  # По одному дню из каждого расписания
    
    # Проверка данных
    assert set(df['schedule'].tolist()) == {"MOEX", "SPBX"}
    assert df[df['schedule'] == "MOEX"]['work_seconds'].iloc[0] == 8 * 3600
    assert df[df['schedule'] == "SPBX"]['work_seconds'].iloc[0] == 9.5 * 3600

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_engine
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine.connect()
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_engine
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

        # Метод должен завершиться без исключения (ошибка обрабатывается внутри)

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_engine
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_engine
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов

def test_get_schedules_happy_path(data_manager, mock_connection, mock_schedule_raw):
    """Тест нормального поведения: получение расписаний и сохранение в БД."""
    # Настройка моков
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.return_value = [mock_schedule_raw]
    
    # Мок для to_sql
    mock_to_sql = MagicMock()
    
    # Мок для engine
    mock_engine = MagicMock()
    mock_connection_obj = MagicMock()
    mock_engine.connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value = mock_connection_obj
    
    with patch('pandas.DataFrame.to_sql', mock_to_sql), \
         patch('sqlalchemy.create_engine', return_value=mock_engine):
        # Вызов тестируемого метода
        from_ = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        to = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 18, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        
        data_manager.get_schedules(from_=from_, to=to)
    
    # Проверка вызова получения расписаний
    data_manager.trading_manager.get_trading_schedules.assert_called_once_with(
        from_=from_, to=to
    )
    
    # Проверка вызова to_sql
    assert mock_to_sql.call_count == 1
    call_args = mock_to_sql.call_args
    
    # Проверка параметров to_sql
    assert call_args.kwargs['con'] == mock_connection_obj
    assert call_args.kwargs['name'] == "schedules"
    assert call_args.kwargs['schema'] == "trading"
    assert call_args.kwargs['if_exists'] == "append"
    assert call_args.kwargs['index'] is False
    
    # Проверка данных в DataFrame
    df = call_args.args[0]
    assert isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
    assert len(df) == 2  # Только 2 торговых дня из 3
    
    # Проверка данных первого торгового дня
    row1 = df.iloc[0]
    assert row1['schedule'] == "MOEX"
    assert row1['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 15)
    assert row1['is_trading_day'] == 1
    assert row1['start_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    assert row1['end_time'] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 15, 18, 0, 0)
    assert row1['work_seconds'] == 8 * 3600  # 8 часов
    
    # Проверка данных второго торгового дня
    row2 = df.iloc[1]
    assert row2['date'] == datetime.date(2024, 1, 17)
    assert row2['work_seconds'] == 7.5 * 3600  # 7.5 часов
