def test_download_candles_delta_happy_path(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест нормального поведения: успешная загрузка дельты данных."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER", "GAZP"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    # Мокируем get_candles_last_dt для разных комбинаций
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(side_effect=[
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # SBER, hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # SBER, 15min
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock()
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert mock_get_candles.call_count == 4
    
    # Проверяем вызовы training_datasets_download
    expected_calls = [
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 14, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
    ]
    
    # Проверяем что все вызовы были, но не обязательно в том же порядке
    assert data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_count == 4
    actual_calls = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args_list
    
    # Сравниваем вызовы без учета finish_date (так как он динамический)
    for i, expected_call in enumerate(expected_calls):
        actual_kwargs = actual_calls[i][1]
        expected_kwargs = expected_call[1]
        
        assert actual_kwargs['tickers'] == expected_kwargs['tickers']
        assert actual_kwargs['time_step_resolutions'] == expected_kwargs['time_step_resolutions']
        assert actual_kwargs['start_date'] == expected_kwargs['start_date']
        assert actual_kwargs['save_mode'] == expected_kwargs['save_mode']
        assert 'finish_date' in actual_kwargs  # Просто проверяем что параметр присутствует


def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=datetime.datetime(
        2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc
    ))
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    # Первый вызов вызывает RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, второй успешен
    call_counts = {"hour": 0, "15min": 0}
    
    def mock_training_download(tickers, time_step_resolutions, **kwargs):
        if "hour" in time_step_resolutions:
            call_counts["hour"] += 1
            if call_counts["hour"] == 1:
                raise Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded")
        elif "15min" in time_step_resolutions:
            call_counts["15min"] += 1
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Мокаем time.sleep чтобы не ждать реально
    with patch("time.sleep") as mock_sleep:
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Для hour должно быть 2 вызова (первый с ошибкой, второй успешный)
        # Для 15min должен быть 1 вызов
        assert call_counts["hour"] == 2
        assert call_counts["15min"] == 1
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)

def test_download_candles_delta_time_delta_calculation(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест правильности расчета временных дельт для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    base_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=base_time)
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    captured_calls = []
    
    def capture_calls(**kwargs):
        captured_calls.append(kwargs)
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=capture_calls)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert len(captured_calls) == 2
    
    # Проверяем hour resolution
    hour_call = next(call for call in captured_calls if call["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"])
    assert hour_call["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    
    # Проверяем 15min resolution
    min15_call = next(call for call in captured_calls if call["time_step_resolutions"] == ["15min"])
    assert min15_call["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)


def test_download_candles_delta_break_after_success(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест, что после успешной загрузки для тикера выходим из цикла по разрешениям."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min", "5min"]
    
    base_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=base_time)
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    call_count = 0
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        nonlocal call_count
        call_count += 1
        # Первый вызов успешен, остальные не должны вызываться из-за break
        if call_count == 1:
            return None
        raise Exception("Этот вызов не должен произойти")
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert call_count == 1  # Только один вызов из-за break
    data_manager.training_datasets_download.assert_called_once()
    
    # Проверяем аргументы вызова
    call_args = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args[1]
    assert call_args["tickers"] == ["SBER"]
    assert call_args["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]
    assert call_args["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    assert call_args["save_mode"] == "append"
    assert "finish_date" in call_args

def test_download_candles_delta_happy_path(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест нормального поведения: успешная загрузка дельты данных."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER", "GAZP"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    # Мокируем get_candles_last_dt для разных комбинаций
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(side_effect=[
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # SBER, hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # SBER, 15min
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock()
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert mock_get_candles.call_count == 4
    
    # Проверяем вызовы training_datasets_download
    expected_calls = [
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 14, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
    ]
    
    # Проверяем что все вызовы были, но не обязательно в том же порядке
    assert data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_count == 4
    actual_calls = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args_list
    
    # Сравниваем вызовы без учета finish_date (так как он динамический)
    for i, expected_call in enumerate(expected_calls):
        actual_kwargs = actual_calls[i][1]
        expected_kwargs = expected_call[1]
        
        assert actual_kwargs['tickers'] == expected_kwargs['tickers']
        assert actual_kwargs['time_step_resolutions'] == expected_kwargs['time_step_resolutions']
        assert actual_kwargs['start_date'] == expected_kwargs['start_date']
        assert actual_kwargs['save_mode'] == expected_kwargs['save_mode']

def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=datetime.datetime(
        2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc
    ))
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    # Первый вызов вызывает RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, второй успешен
    call_counts = {"hour": 0, "15min": 0}
    
    def mock_training_download(tickers, time_step_resolutions, **kwargs):
        if "hour" in time_step_resolutions:
            call_counts["hour"] += 1
            if call_counts["hour"] == 1:
                raise Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded")
        elif "15min" in time_step_resolutions:
            call_counts["15min"] += 1
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Мокаем time.sleep чтобы не ждать реально
    with patch("time.sleep") as mock_sleep:
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Для hour должно быть 2 вызова (первый с ошибкой, второй успешный)
        # Для 15min должен быть 1 вызов
        assert call_counts["hour"] == 2
        assert call_counts["15min"] == 1
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)

    captured_calls = []
    
    def capture_calls(**kwargs):
        captured_calls.append(kwargs)
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=capture_calls)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)

    # Проверяем 15min resolution

    assert min15_call["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)


def test_download_candles_delta_break_after_success(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест, что после успешной загрузки для тикера выходим из цикла по разрешениям."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min", "5min"]

    call_count = 0
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        nonlocal call_count
        call_count += 1
        # Первый вызов успешен, остальные не должны вызываться из-за break
        if call_count == 1:
            return None
        raise Exception("Этот вызов не должен произойти")
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert call_count == 1  # Только один вызов из-за break
    data_manager.training_datasets_download.assert_called_once()
    
    # Проверяем аргументы вызова
    call_args = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args[1]
    assert call_args["tickers"] == ["SBER"]
    assert call_args["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]
    assert call_args["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    assert call_args["save_mode"] == "append"
    assert "finish_date" in call_args

        assert 'finish_date' in actual_kwargs  # Просто проверяем что параметр присутствует


def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(side_effect=[
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    # Счетчики вызовов для каждого разрешения
    call_counts = {"hour": 0, "15min": 0}
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        resolutions = kwargs['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        if resolutions == "hour":
            call_counts["hour"] += 1
            if call_counts["hour"] == 1:
                raise Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded")
        elif resolutions == "15min":
            call_counts["15min"] += 1
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Мокаем time.sleep чтобы не ждать реально
    with patch("time.sleep") as mock_sleep:
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Для hour должно быть 2 вызова (первый с ошибкой, второй успешный)
        # Для 15min должен быть 1 вызов
        assert call_counts["hour"] == 2
        assert call_counts["15min"] == 1
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)

    """Тест правильности расчета временных дельт для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    # Мокируем get_candles_last_dt для каждого разрешения
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(side_effect=[
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    captured_calls = []
    
    def capture_calls(**kwargs):
        captured_calls.append(kwargs)
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=capture_calls)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert len(captured_calls) == 2
    
    # Сортируем вызовы по разрешениям
    captured_calls_sorted = sorted(captured_calls, key=lambda x: x["time_step_resolutions"][0])
    
    # Проверяем hour resolution
    hour_call = captured_calls_sorted[0]
    assert hour_call["time_step_resolutions"] == ["15min"]
    assert hour_call["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    
    # Проверяем 15min resolution
    min15_call = captured_calls_sorted[1]
    assert min15_call["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]
    assert min15_call["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)


def test_download_candles_delta_break_after_success(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест, что после успешной загрузки для тикера выходим из цикла по разрешениям."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min", "5min"]
    
    base_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=base_time)
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    call_count = 0
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        nonlocal call_count
        call_count += 1
        # Первый вызов успешен, остальные не должны вызываться из-за break
        if call_count == 1:
            return None
        raise Exception("Этот вызов не должен произойти")
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert call_count == 1  # Только один вызов из-за break
    data_manager.training_datasets_download.assert_called_once()
    
    # Проверяем аргументы вызова
    call_args = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args[1]
    assert call_args["tickers"] == ["SBER"]
    assert call_args["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]
    assert call_args["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    assert call_args["save_mode"] == "append"
    assert "finish_date" in call_args

def test_download_candles_delta_happy_path(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):

        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock()
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert

    # Проверяем вызовы training_datasets_download
    expected_calls = [
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 14, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
    ]

    actual_calls = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args_list
    
    # Сортируем вызовы по тикерам и разрешениям для сравнения
    def sort_key(call_item):
        ticker = call_item[1]['tickers'][0]
        resolution = call_item[1]['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        return (ticker, resolution)
    
    actual_calls_sorted = sorted(actual_calls, key=sort_key)
    expected_calls_sorted = sorted(expected_calls, key=lambda x: (x[1]['tickers'][0], x[1]['time_step_resolutions'][0]))
    
    # Сравниваем вызовы без учета finish_date (так как он динамический)
    for i, expected_call in enumerate(expected_calls_sorted):
        actual_kwargs = actual_calls_sorted[i][1]
        expected_kwargs = expected_call[1]
        
        assert actual_kwargs['tickers'] == expected_kwargs['tickers']
        assert actual_kwargs['time_step_resolutions'] == expected_kwargs['time_step_resolutions']

        assert actual_kwargs['save_mode'] == expected_kwargs['save_mode']

    data_manager.training_datasets_download.assert_called_once()
    
    # Проверяем аргументы вызова

    assert call_args["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]

        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles

    # Act

    # Assert
    assert mock_get_candles.call_count == 4
    
    # Проверяем вызовы training_datasets_download
    expected_calls = [
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 14, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
    ]
    
    # Проверяем что все вызовы были, но не обязательно в том же порядке
    assert data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_count == 4
    actual_calls = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args_list
    
    # Сортируем вызовы по тикерам и разрешениям для сравнения
    def sort_key(call_item):
        ticker = call_item[1]['tickers'][0]
        resolution = call_item[1]['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        return (ticker, resolution)
    
    actual_calls_sorted = sorted(actual_calls, key=sort_key)
    expected_calls_sorted = sorted(expected_calls, key=lambda x: (x[1]['tickers'][0], x[1]['time_step_resolutions'][0]))
    
    # Сравниваем вызовы без учета finish_date (так как он динамический)
    for i, expected_call in enumerate(expected_calls_sorted):
        actual_kwargs = actual_calls_sorted[i][1]
        expected_kwargs = expected_call[1]
        
        assert actual_kwargs['tickers'] == expected_kwargs['tickers']
        assert actual_kwargs['time_step_resolutions'] == expected_kwargs['time_step_resolutions']
        assert actual_kwargs['start_date'] == expected_kwargs['start_date']
        assert actual_kwargs['save_mode'] == expected_kwargs['save_mode']

def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(side_effect=[
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    # Счетчики вызовов для каждого разрешения
    call_counts = {"hour": 0, "15min": 0}
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        resolutions = kwargs['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        if resolutions == "hour":
            call_counts["hour"] += 1
            if call_counts["hour"] == 1:
                raise Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded")
        elif resolutions == "15min":
            call_counts["15min"] += 1
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Мокаем time.sleep чтобы не ждать реально
    with patch("time.sleep") as mock_sleep:
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Для hour должно быть 2 вызова (первый с ошибкой, второй успешный)
        # Для 15min должен быть 1 вызов
        assert call_counts["hour"] == 2
        assert call_counts["15min"] == 1
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)

def test_download_candles_delta_no_break_on_error(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест, что при ошибке в одном разрешении продолжается обработка других разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min", "5min"]
    
    base_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=base_time)
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    call_sequence = []
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        resolution = kwargs['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        call_sequence.append(resolution)
        if resolution == "hour":
            raise Exception("Ошибка в hour")
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Act & Assert
    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="Ошибка в hour"):
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Проверяем, что только первый вызов произошел (break после первой ошибки)
    assert call_sequence == ["hour"]
    assert data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_count == 1

    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]

        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # GAZP, 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock()
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert mock_get_candles.call_count == 4
    
    # Проверяем вызовы training_datasets_download
    expected_calls = [
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["SBER"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["hour"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 14, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
        call(
            tickers=["GAZP"],
            time_step_resolutions=["15min"],
            start_date=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
            finish_date=MagicMock(),
            save_mode="append"
        ),
    ]

    # Сортируем вызовы по тикерам и разрешениям для сравнения
    def sort_key(call_item):
        ticker = call_item[1]['tickers'][0]
        resolution = call_item[1]['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        return (ticker, resolution)
    
    actual_calls_sorted = sorted(actual_calls, key=sort_key)
    expected_calls_sorted = sorted(expected_calls, key=lambda x: (x[1]['tickers'][0], x[1]['time_step_resolutions'][0]))
    
    # Сравниваем вызовы без учета finish_date (так как он динамический)
    for i, expected_call in enumerate(expected_calls_sorted):
        actual_kwargs = actual_calls_sorted[i][1]
        expected_kwargs = expected_call[1]
        
        assert actual_kwargs['tickers'] == expected_kwargs['tickers']
        assert actual_kwargs['time_step_resolutions'] == expected_kwargs['time_step_resolutions']
        assert actual_kwargs['start_date'] == expected_kwargs['start_date']
        assert actual_kwargs['save_mode'] == expected_kwargs['save_mode']
        assert 'finish_date' in actual_kwargs  # Просто проверяем что параметр присутствует


def test_download_candles_delta_resource_exhausted_retry(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест обработки ошибки RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED с повторной попыткой."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(side_effect=[
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    # Счетчики вызовов для каждого разрешения
    call_counts = {"hour": 0, "15min": 0}
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        resolutions = kwargs['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        if resolutions == "hour":
            call_counts["hour"] += 1
            if call_counts["hour"] == 1:
                raise Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded")
        elif resolutions == "15min":
            call_counts["15min"] += 1
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Мокаем time.sleep чтобы не ждать реально
    with patch("time.sleep") as mock_sleep:
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Для hour должно быть 2 вызова (первый с ошибкой, второй успешный)
        # Для 15min должен быть 1 вызов
        assert call_counts["hour"] == 2
        assert call_counts["15min"] == 1
        mock_sleep.assert_called_once_with(30)

def test_download_candles_delta_break_after_success(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест, что после успешной загрузки для тикера выходим из цикла по разрешениям."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min", "5min"]
    
    base_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=base_time)
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    call_count = 0
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        nonlocal call_count
        call_count += 1
        # Первый вызов успешен, остальные не должны вызываться из-за break
        if call_count == 1:
            return None
        raise Exception("Этот вызов не должен произойти")
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert call_count == 1  # Только один вызов из-за break
    data_manager.training_datasets_download.assert_called_once()
    
    # Проверяем аргументы вызова
    call_args = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args[1]
    assert call_args["tickers"] == ["SBER"]
    assert call_args["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]
    assert call_args["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    assert call_args["save_mode"] == "append"
    assert "finish_date" in call_args

        resolutions = kwargs['time_step_resolutions'][0]
        if resolutions == "hour":
            call_counts["hour"] += 1
            if call_counts["hour"] == 1:
                raise Exception("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Some limit exceeded")
        elif resolutions == "15min":
            call_counts["15min"] += 1
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Мокаем time.sleep чтобы не ждать реально
    with patch("time.sleep") as mock_sleep:
        # Act
        data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
        
        # Assert
        # Для hour должно быть 2 вызова (первый с ошибкой, второй успешный)

def test_download_candles_delta_time_delta_calculation(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест правильности расчета временных дельт для разных разрешений."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min"]
    
    # Мокируем get_candles_last_dt для каждого разрешения
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(side_effect=[
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # hour
        datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),  # 15min
    ])
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    captured_calls = []
    
    def capture_calls(**kwargs):
        captured_calls.append(kwargs)
        return None
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=capture_calls)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert len(captured_calls) == 2
    
    # Сортируем вызовы по разрешениям
    captured_calls_sorted = sorted(captured_calls, key=lambda x: x["time_step_resolutions"][0])
    
    # Проверяем hour resolution
    hour_call = captured_calls_sorted[1]  # hour идет вторым после сортировки
    assert hour_call["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]
    assert hour_call["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    
    # Проверяем 15min resolution
    min15_call = captured_calls_sorted[0]  # 15min идет первым после сортировки
    assert min15_call["time_step_resolutions"] == ["15min"]
    assert min15_call["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)


def test_download_candles_delta_break_after_success(data_manager, mock_trading_manager):
    """Тест, что после успешной загрузки для тикера выходим из цикла по разрешениям."""
    # Arrange
    tickers = ["SBER"]
    time_step_resolutions = ["hour", "15min", "5min"]
    
    base_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    mock_get_candles = MagicMock(return_value=base_time)
    data_manager.get_candles_last_dt = mock_get_candles
    
    call_count = 0
    
    def mock_training_download(**kwargs):
        nonlocal call_count
        call_count += 1
        # Первый вызов успешен, остальные не должны вызываться из-за break
        if call_count == 1:
            return None
        raise Exception("Этот вызов не должен произойти")
    
    data_manager.training_datasets_download = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_training_download)
    
    # Act
    data_manager.download_candles_delta(tickers, time_step_resolutions)
    
    # Assert
    assert call_count == 1  # Только один вызов из-за break
    data_manager.training_datasets_download.assert_called_once()
    
    # Проверяем аргументы вызова
    call_args = data_manager.training_datasets_download.call_args[1]
    assert call_args["tickers"] == ["SBER"]
    assert call_args["time_step_resolutions"] == ["hour"]
    assert call_args["start_date"] == datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    assert call_args["save_mode"] == "append"
    assert "finish_date" in call_args
